result:
Round 6 fails verification: two acceptance checks didn't pass, though most of the round works. Most of the testing was done by the previous C session before its context restart. I confirmed the source hadn't changed since, re-ran the open checks, and wrote the verdict.

**Failed**
- **RF6-2, video sync drift (Medium, C-R6-02).**
  - 30 runs of the standard two-clip video layout: 22 PASS, 6 FAIL, 2 invalid. The worst error was 0.206 s against a 0.1 s limit.
  - Round 5 had 15/15 pass, with no slow frames caused by app code. 8 of this round's runs have them: the playback frame loop, the video sync step, and one 62 ms React render right after Play.
  - The video start-timing check passed cleanly in only 4 of 9 runs. In 3 runs the video really didn't start within 300 ms of the audio.
  - The machine was at 23ΓÇô100 % CPU. The playback loop normally costs about 0.1ΓÇô0.2 ms per frame, so the load may have caused some of this; it isn't proven either way. The task's rules count these slow frames against the app, so it's a FAIL. A run on a quiet machine (Tech Lead check) will settle the cause.
- **R10-N5, Fit view (Low, C-R6-03).** After Fit, the last ruler label sticks 19 px past the end of the timeline and adds horizontal scroll. Everything else in that check works, including Fit on a 27-minute project.

**Passed**
- **Gesture guard, end-of-project Play, list titles, drag ghost, paste message, Shift hint, docs:** all pass.
- **RF6-1 (escalation spacing):** passes with a note. In 2 of 6 runs one correction fired 21ΓÇô29 ms after the forced lag ended. That's correct behaviour, but B should reword the criterion.
- **Navigation (all other Track U checks):** ruler drag, Ctrl+wheel, overview, Follow, playing without side effects, performance, layout. I ran Z/X, +/ΓêÆ and the overview arrows with real key presses this session.
- **Follow off:** the previous session's check was invalid because the test clicked the button twice. I re-tested it: the view stays still while the playhead leaves it.

**Premium access is not bypassed.** Signed out, the Studio token endpoint returns 401. A fake token gets a 500 and no token, but the backend was down, so that result is limited. The purchased `/studio/middle-east` page shows "Sign in required". Through import, play and export, the browser only requested the two demo MP3s and local blob media.

**The real user flow works end to end.** I searched for the bass stem, previewed it, dragged it onto the stems lane at 10 s, imported a test video and played from 9 s. The bass started exactly 1.0 s later at the audio output. The exported WAV (24-bit, 48 kHz, 26 s) is silent from 6 to 10 s and the bass starts at 10.000 s. A separate export compared sample by sample against the source differed only by 24-bit rounding.

Type check, the full test suite (761/761), build and protected-file hashes all pass, and `Header.tsx` is unchanged. I made no app edits.

21 older regression checks were not re-run this round, so they are listed separately and not counted as passed. The report also carries the open items from the root reviews: the hardcoded `middle-east` in the purchased Studio loader, a wheel-scroll check on `/studio/*`, the three items left from the round-6 checkpoint review, and T12 Gain/Volume not started.

Everything is in `tmp/studio-real-loop/`; start with `c-round-6.md`.
